No error handling exists anywhere in the new code path, so a failed DELETE leaves the member list stale and produces only an unhandled rejection with no admin feedback. The mechanism is real, though severity is modest (error-path only, same pattern as the sibling addMembers).

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that in the removeMember action (lines 51-58), the promise returned by `self.get('model').removeMember(member)` is not handled within the bootbox.confirm callback. Looking at the diff, the removeMember method in group.js returns a Discourse.ajax promise. When called inside the bootbox callback, if the AJAX request fails, there's no .catch() or error handling, so the failure would be silent to the user (only appearing as an unhandled rejection in console). This is a real bug - failed member removals won't show any error feedback to the administrator.
